findings.title: (merges SEC-R8-I3) README L77 still says `npm start` serves http://127.0.0.1:3000, and live-paypal.md L115 lists 127.0.0.1 first, while the corrected demo text says to use localhost
findings.detail:
**What the reworked text says.** README L13 now tells a person to open http://localhost:3000, and why: without RS_PUBLIC_URL the simulated approval returns to localhost, and the session belongs to the host name used. My human-style run confirms that this works.

**What still says otherwise.** The 'Install, seed, start, test' block (L77: 'npm start # starts the server on http://127.0.0.1:3000') and docs/runbooks/live-paypal.md L115 ('Open http://127.0.0.1:3000 or http://localhost:3000') still point at 127.0.0.1. A reader who starts from that section, not the one-command demo, can open 127.0.0.1 and come back signed out after the simulated approval, which is the very defect the engineer found.

**This is not a security issue:** the bind is 127.0.0.1 (config.js L243).
findings.recommendation:
Owner: orchestrator (one-line docs change, or the verification report). Resolved when either:
- README L77 reads 'starts the server; open http://localhost:3000' and live-paypal.md L115 lists localhost first (or only); or
- the verification report lists both lines as known wording, with the localhost advice.

findings.title: The table's cited-run check reads recorded logs: a cited test later disabled (test.skip) in its own file stays green
findings.detail:
**Probe PAMB2** (ev:ev-mv4hqnxx-011fd37d; the control is green in the same run). The cited RS-25 timeout test was changed to `test.skip` in lost-response.test.js. Its title stays in that file only, so the one-file binding holds, and the cited (recorded) logs still show it ok. evidence-table.test.js stays 15/15.

**What would catch it.** A full run of the final tree would show 9 skips instead of 8, but nothing ties that count to the table.

This is a residual of design: the table cites runs, not the current tree. It is not a regression.
findings.recommendation: No change required for this gate. Owner: delivery-lead (verification report) or a later maintenance change. Resolved when the verification report notes this, or evidence-table.test.js also requires each cited title to sit in a test/it call that is not .skip/.todo (a static check that PAMB2 would then fail).
